free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: q/k/v head count is not part of the Region condition; 2 query heads lets block_idx[0] be a list of two head tensors so len(block_idx[0]) == num_q_heads on the negative

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: matches num_q_heads so the later GQA assertion (below the target) is not the thing under test

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for deterministic CPU tensor contents; contents do not enter the target condition

execution.entry_reason: flex_prefill_attention (call_chain[0]) does not take block_idx; it builds list[list[Tensor]] internally via get_active_blocks, so the malformed list-of-Tensor shape the Region is about cannot be supplied through it without patching code that runs before the target. The driver therefore calls the target function triton_block_wise_prefill_attention (call_chain[1]) directly with a real q/k/v and an explicitly constructed block_idx; the target line and its own body are the real repository code and no stand-ins are used.
